name: Post-discharge care
raw_data_rulebook: IP or ED encounter, discharge date
fires_when_rulebook: Discharge in the last 14 days, or 2 or more ED visits in 90 days

name: HbA1c above target
status: Draft: needs clinical sign-off (rulebook §8). Extract flag fires at 6.5%: decide which variant to use

name: Kidney check
fires_when_rulebook: eGFR < 60, or no eGFR/UACR in 12 months

name: Medication adherence
fires_when_rulebook: PDC < 80% over 180 days, or a gap of more than 30 days

name: High-risk foot
fires_when_rulebook: No exam in 12 months, or a high-risk code

name: Potassium due
fires_when_rulebook: On an RAAS inhibitor or diuretic with no K+ in 12 months

name: New diagnosis
fires_when_rulebook: First code in the last 90 days
